note: Written before any spot-check signal (ticket records for any sampled block, City web pages, hosted paMeter records) was fetched. Only signal vocabularies/field lists were read: parking-tickets infraction-text and status counts citywide, and 3 unfiltered records for field formats.
common_meter_filter: service_status='In Service' AND vehicle_type='Any Vehicle' AND time_limit_override='No' AND prohibition_override='No' AND both rates present AND all four time limits in ('2 Hr','3 Hr','4 Hr')  [Removed, Out of Service, motorcycle, accessibility, EV, override, null/No-Time-Limit/13 Hr/30 Min limits excluded]

MT.where: common AND no am/pm rush AND no prohibition zone
MT.claim: PAID 09:00-18:00 at rate_9am_6pm and 18:00-22:00 at rate_6pm_10pm, every day, with the listed weekday/weekend limits; VERIFIED_FREE 22:00-09:00 (E2 after-hours, prohibition and limit fields present and empty of restrictions)

MR.where: common AND (am OR pm rush) AND no prohibition zone
MR.claim: RESTRICTED (no stopping) during each rush window on every day (days undocumented, so conservative); PAID as MT otherwise 09:00-22:00; 22:00-09:00 UNKNOWN except the AM rush window, which is RESTRICTED

MX.case: no-parking / prohibition zone on a meter
MX.where: common AND prohibition_1 zone, days and time all present (and slot 2 complete if present)
MX.claim: RESTRICTED (the named zone) on the listed days and times for both slots; PAID as MT otherwise 09:00-22:00; otherwise UNKNOWN

P.where: public-streets hblock (streetuse != Closed) whose geo_point_2d lies inside any ResidentialParkingPermitZones polygon (RPP, RPO or VRPP), excluding every hblock to which a non-Removed meter maps (nearest or within 30 m)
P.claim: RESTRICTED (resident permit program of the containing polygon) at all times; never free; hours UNKNOWN

sampling: keys = sorted feature_id (MT, MR, MX) or sorted distinct hblock (P); rng = random.Random(20261023); for stratum in ['MT','MR','MX','P']: rng.sample(keys, 3). 12 checks.
block_mapping: Meter point -> nearest public-streets hblock by planar distance (equirectangular, lat0 49.25). Must be <= 30 m. If a different hblock is within 3 m of the nearest, the check is UNVERIFIED (block ambiguous); no re-draw.
counted_signal: City of Vancouver parking-tickets (current dataset, 2026 tickets), all statuses, rows with block = hblock number AND street = hblock street text exactly. If the street text has no 2026 ticket anywhere in the city, the check is UNVERIFIED (name mismatch). Location precision is the 100-block, both sides; no time of day is published.

CLASS: RESERVED FOR ONE OR MORE CLASS OF VEHICLE
BIKE: DESIGNATED FOR USE BY PERSONS ON BICYCLES
TL: LONGER PERIOD OF TIME THAN INDICATED

represented_by_meters_on_block.NS: any non-Removed meter mapped to the block with a NO STOPPING prohibition zone or any rush window
represented_by_meters_on_block.CLASS: TAXI/POLICE/MILITARY/AUTHORIZED VEHICLES ONLY/PERMIT PARKING ONLY zone, or a meter with vehicle_type other than Any Vehicle
represented_by_meters_on_block.SR: any prohibition zone or a non-Any-Vehicle meter

contradiction_rule.MT_MR_MX: CONTRADICTION if the block has a 2026 ticket in NS, RUSH, CLZ, LZ, PZ, TOUR, BUS, CLASS, DIS, BIKE, NP or SR that is not represented by the meters mapped to that block. Rationale: the feed gives points, not curb extents, so an unrepresented signed restriction on the same block cannot be excluded from the claimed curb (fails closed; side-blind).
contradiction_rule.P: CONTRADICTION if the block has any 2026 METER ticket (payment applies, contrary to a permit-only claim and to the frame excluding metered blocks).
contradiction_rule.general: CONTRADICTION for every MT/MR/MX check if the City meter web page states paid hours other than 9am-10pm daily, or states that rush/prohibition signs do not override payment.

agreement_rule.MT: no contradiction AND >=1 2026 METER ticket on the block
agreement_rule.MR: no contradiction AND >=1 METER ticket AND >=1 RUSH or NS ticket on the block
agreement_rule.MX: no contradiction AND >=1 METER ticket AND >=1 ticket in the category matching the zone (NO STOPPING->NS, LOADING ZONE->LZ or CLZ, CVLZ->CLZ or LZ, PASSENGER ZONE->PZ, TOUR BUS ZONE->TOUR, other->CLASS)
agreement_rule.P: no contradiction AND >=1 SR or NP ticket on the block

not_counted: Statutory location offences (hydrant, crosswalk, intersection, curb distance, driveway, lane, direction, large vehicle, derelict, boulevard, sidewalk), TL, water/idling/snow. The hosted paMeter layer (same City asset system, FID_METER = feature_id) is compared per sampled meter as a transcription check only; it is not independent. The RPP record URL page is read as program corroboration only.
pass_rule: Subset passes criterion 7 only if >=10 checks AGREE, 0 CONTRADICT, and each case type (MT, MR, MX, P) has >=1 AGREE. Any contradiction: the subset stays pending; a narrower subset needs a new pre-registration and a new seed, never a re-draw of this one.
